biotools.summary: Offline, deterministic bioinformatics command-line analysis of amino-acid composition and ambiguous residues in protein FASTA files, and observed first-model C-alpha residue inventory in PDB coordinate files. Reports source SHA-256 and bounded quality warnings. Does not infer protein structures or validate molecular geometry.
